description: APOLLO-Live supports group decisions about energy and climate policy through an online questionnaire and ranking workflow. The development team publishes a stable version on Zenodo and source code on GitHub under Apache-2.0, allowing free reuse. Moderators configure alternatives and questions, participants contribute responses, and the system calculates results using TOPSIS. Its repository documents a .NET-based server and database configuration for local deployment. Coverage depends on the workshop or policy scenario supplied by users, not a predefined geography or year. The tool models preference aggregation and consensus; it does not simulate physical electricity flows. It can support the decision component of infrastructure-policy or actor simulations, provided elicited weights are not mistaken for measured technical performance. No directly related catalogue record was identified; the deployed service was not tested.
